title: For each security group, show the security group ID and the geometric mean
question: For each security group, show the security group ID and the geometric mean of the standard attribute IDs of the ports bound to that security group, considering only ports whose standard attribute ID is greater than 0 and whose tenant ID is `17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7`.        EXP(AVG(LN(p.standard_attr_id))) AS geom_mean
FROM securitygroupportbindings AS b
JOIN ports AS p ON p.id = b.port_id
WHERE p.standard_attr_id > 0
  AND p.tenant_id = '17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7'
